newsitem.title: USA: Rangel named top House Ways and Means Democrat.
newsitem.headline: Rangel named top House Ways and Means Democrat.

text.p: Rep. Charles Rangel of New York was named Wednesday as senior Democrat on the House Ways and Means Committee, which writes tax and trade legislation.
Rangel succeeds Rep. Sam Gibbons of Florida, who did not run for re-election. Texas Republican Bill Archer is chairman of the committee, which is controlled by Republicans.

"This position allows me to play a key role, representing the president and the House (Democrat) leadership on the Ways and Means Committee," Rangel said in a statement. He was chosen by his fellow House Democrats.
